en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad unpaved street lined with leafless trees and wooden fences. On the right are large wooden houses behind a picket fence; on the left are more buildings and a few pedestrians. In the distant background a church spire rises over the town. Handwritten notes in a cursive script appear at the top and bottom margins of the image.
